items.title: Starknet Votes to Explore Going Solo as a Post-Quantum L1
items.summary: 93.5% of voting power backed researching a standalone post-quantum chain, though any actual switch would still need another community vote.

items.title: OpenZeppelin Brings Confidential Balances and Transfers to Stellar
items.summary: OpenZeppelin is delivering the next major addition to its contracts library for Stellar: Confidential Token contracts.

items.title: Ethereum Researchers Draft a Consensus Overhaul for Faster Finality
items.summary: A draft EIP would split Ethereum’s validator voting in two, chasing faster finality, sturdier fork choice, and a path to post-quantum signatures.

items.title: Aerodrome and Velodrome Go Live as Aero Across Seven Chains
items.summary: VELO holders now convert into AERO, with the merged supply split 94.5% to Aerodrome's side and 5.5% to Velodrome's.
